column3: “Will call” is rendered “has called,” and NASB adds “Even.”
“Flood of wrath” is rendered “outburst of anger,” and “covenant loyalty” as “lovingkindness.”
“The water of Noah” is rendered “the days of Noah,” following a different reading.
“Ruby … beryl” is rendered “rubies … crystal,” and “border” as “wall.”
“Their righteousness” (at the end) is rendered “their vindication.”
